annotations.title: How many LIHTC properties reach Year 15, by year

description: Counts of tax credit properties, total units and low-income units whose estimated 15-year compliance periods end in each year from 2023 to 2032, for one state or the whole US, from HUD's LIHTC database (placed in service 2009 to 2018).

state.description: Two-letter state or territory code, e.g. CA. Omit for the national totals.
